title: Kevin Owens Returning To WWE NXT, John Cena Misses Wrestling Every Day - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
2 hours ago
John Cena may have stepped away from in-ring competition in WWE, but the 17-time World Champion still finds himself reflecting on his career and everything that came with it.
Cena recently admitted that he misses performing for WWE every day, though he remains confident that retiring was the right decision. After wrapping up his final run in 2025, the wrestling legend was able to say goodbye to the ring on his own terms.
Speaking to PEOPLE at Monday’s New York City premiere of Matchbox: The Movie , Cena discussed how nostalgia has become a regular part of his life, explaining that he often looks back on different stages of his journey, from his early wrestling days to his childhood. He said,
“I have moments of nostalgic reflection on the daily. A lot of times, that’s when you’re overwhelmed by stress or confused or maybe you don’t know the answers that you’re trying to seek. Nostalgia is in itself looking back to a simpler time in the unknown or during crisis. I got daily moments of that, man. Daily. I’ll look back on my early wrestling days, or I’ll look back on college days, or I’ll look back on my life in dormitory school, or even as a kid. That happens on the daily, man.”

“I miss all of it every day. I miss performing every single day,” Cena said.
“Just because I miss it here [in my heart] doesn’t make it the right decision here [in my head].”
Kevin Owens is heading back to NXT.
WWE has announced that Owens will be appearing at the NXT live event on Saturday, October 17, at the Slush Puppie Centre in Gatineau, Quebec, Canada.
Other names advertised for the event include Grayson Waller, Tony D’Angelo, Cruz Montana, Zaria, Shiloh Hill, and the Vanity Project, consisting of Jackson Drake, Ricky Smokes, and Brad Baylor.
Owens is a former NXT World Champion, but he has not competed inside an NXT ring since NXT TakeOver: WarGames 2019. At that event, Owens served as the mystery partner for Donovan Dijak, Keith Lee, and Tommaso Ciampa.
